name: agentic-work-os
description: A lightweight harness that drives Claude Code CLI and OpenAI Codex in one thread.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @awos/protocol && npm run build --workspace @awos/core && npm run build --workspace @awos/ui
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @awos/ui
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @awos/protocol && npm run test --workspace @awos/protocol && npm run test --workspace @awos/core && npm run test --workspace @awos/ui
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @awos/protocol && npm run build --workspace @awos/core && concurrently -n tsc,core,ui -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run watch --workspace @awos/core" "npm run dev --workspace @awos/core" "npm run dev --workspace @awos/ui"
scripts.desktop: npm run build --workspace @awos/protocol && npm run build --workspace @awos/core && npm run dev --workspace @awos/desktop
